progression.narrative: The performance opens on E3 and dwells most on Db in Zabol. Chaharmezrab (1:28.5) introduces Eb, centred on A. The line peaks at E4 (341.5 Hz) at 1:12.4. It closes on the tonic (D4 → D4 → D4 → Eb4 → A3 → A3).
